title: Fractured Cinema Dream
description: A surreal portrait of a man with a cracked golden face holding a framed painting of a melting rainbow orb. His left eye is a dripping cosmic orb while cinematic film strips burn around him against a dark apocalyptic cityscape with candles and floating broken faces.
